Fusion deltas retain explicit per-output order; existing current729 full GPU suites additionally exercise prefill competing-tile byte invariance and independent sampled float64 references. replaces fixtures gate3 checks exact bytes and skips ordinary-shape FP64 error computation; worst0 is replacement-byte equality, not zero FP64 absolute error.
Logs report worst normalized error/bound for non-replacement fixtures. They do not retain full per-column absolute errors or aggregate error vectors; those cannot be fabricated.
No numeric order conclusion waives remaining current-head registration, model/history, lifecycle, context or CI gates.

If maintainers require exported per-column/aggregate absolute errors despite no reduction-order trigger, minimally extend a diagnostic projection runner over identical rows and unchanged FP64 formula; not all22 model reruns.
